skills.name: 死生徘徊
skills.desc:
普攻·摄召
若景燃处于负阴状态，可进行最多4段连续攻击，造成热熔伤害。
施放普攻·摄召第3段时可获得50点【炁】，且此伤害为重击伤害。
施放普攻·摄召第4段时可获得50点【炁】，且此伤害为重击伤害。

普攻·灭煞
若景燃处于抱阳状态，可进行最多4段连续攻击，造成热熔伤害。
施放普攻·灭煞第3段时可获得50点【炁】，且此伤害为重击伤害。
施放普攻·灭煞第4段时可获得50点【炁】，且此伤害为重击伤害。

空中攻击
消耗耐力进行空中下落攻击，造成热熔伤害。
若景燃处于负阴状态，施放该技能后的一定时间内，按下普攻将会施放普攻·摄召第2段。
若景燃处于抱阳状态，施放该技能后的一定时间内，按下普攻将会施放普攻·灭煞第2段。

闪避反击·探幽
若景燃处于负阴状态，成功闪避后一定时间内按下普攻，将会攻击目标，造成热熔伤害。
施放闪避反击·探幽时可获得100点【炁】，且此伤害为重击伤害。
施放该技能后的一定时间内，按下普攻将会施放普攻·摄召第4段。

闪避反击·守明
若景燃处于抱阳状态，成功闪避后一定时间内按下普攻，将会攻击目标，造成热熔伤害。
施放闪避反击·守明时可获得100点【炁】，且此伤害为重击伤害。
施放该技能后的一定时间内，按下普攻将会施放普攻·灭煞第4段。

潜影
景燃处于战斗状态下，且在地面时，向前短按闪避可施放潜影，造成固定热熔伤害，此次伤害为普攻伤害，不受伤害加成影响，施放该技能一定时间内可以触发成功闪避。
若景燃处于负阴状态，施放该技能后的一定时间内，按下普攻将会施放普攻·摄召第2段。
若景燃处于抱阳状态，施放该技能后的一定时间内，按下普攻将会施放普攻·灭煞第2段。
skills.descEn:
Basic Attack - Drink Soul
While in the Yin Vessel state, perform up to 4 consecutive attacks, dealing Fusion DMG.
Casting Basic Attack - Drink Soul Stage 3 restores 50 {Cus:Sap,S=point P=points SapTag=0} of Qi, dealing Heavy Attack DMG.
Casting Basic Attack - Drink Soul Stage 4 restores 50 {Cus:Sap,S=point P=points SapTag=1} of Qi, dealing Heavy Attack DMG.

Basic Attack - Devil's Bane
While in the Yang Font state, perform up to 4 consecutive attacks, dealing Fusion DMG.
Casting Basic Attack - Devil's Bane Stage 3 restores 50 {Cus:Sap,S=point P=points SapTag=2} of Qi, dealing Heavy Attack DMG.
Casting Basic Attack - Devil's Bane Stage 4 restores 50 {Cus:Sap,S=point P=points SapTag=3} of Qi, dealing Heavy Attack DMG.

Mid-air Attack
Consume STA to perform a Plunging Attack in the air, dealing Fusion DMG.
While in the Yin Vessel state, {Cus:Ipt,Touch=tap PC=press Gamepad=press} or hold Normal Attack shortly after casting this skill to cast Basic Attack - Drink Soul Stage 2.
While in the Yang Font state, {Cus:Ipt,Touch=tap PC=press Gamepad=press} or hold Normal Attack shortly after casting this skill to cast Basic Attack - Devil's Bane Stage 2.

Dodge Counter - Nether Dive
While in the Yin Vessel state, {Cus:Ipt,Touch=tap PC=press Gamepad=press} or hold Normal Attack shortly after a successful Dodge to attack the target, dealing Fusion DMG.
Casting Dodge Counter - Nether Dive restores 100 {Cus:Sap,S=point P=points SapTag=4} of Qi, dealing Heavy Attack DMG.
{Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} or hold Normal Attack shortly after casting this skill to cast Basic Attack - Drink Soul Stage 4.

Dodge Counter - Light Watch
While in the Yang Font state, {Cus:Ipt,Touch=tap PC=press Gamepad=press} or hold Normal Attack shortly after a successful Dodge to attack the target, dealing Fusion DMG.
Casting Dodge Counter - Light Watch restores 100 {Cus:Sap,S=point P=points SapTag=5} of Qi, dealing Heavy Attack DMG.
{Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} or hold Normal Attack shortly after casting this skill to cast Basic Attack - Devil's Bane Stage 4.

Shadow Step
While in combat and on the ground, {Cus:Ipt,Touch=tap PC=press Gamepad=press} Dodge with directional input to cast Shadow Step, dealing a fixed amount of Fusion DMG, considered Basic Attack DMG. This instance of damage is not affected by any DMG Bonus effects. A successful Dodge may be triggered within a certain time during the action of this skill.
While in the Yin Vessel state, {Cus:Ipt,Touch=tap PC=press Gamepad=press} or hold Normal Attack shortly after casting this skill to cast Basic Attack - Drink Soul Stage 2.
While in the Yang Font state, {Cus:Ipt,Touch=tap PC=press Gamepad=press} or hold Normal Attack shortly after casting this skill to cast Basic Attack - Devil's Bane Stage 2.

skills.name: 撞煞
skills.desc:
共鸣技能·阴蚀骨
若景燃处于负阴状态，可施放共鸣技能·阴蚀骨，攻击目标，造成热熔伤害。
共鸣技能·阴蚀骨可在空中施放。

共鸣技能·阳焚身
若景燃处于抱阳状态，可施放共鸣技能·阳焚身，攻击目标，造成热熔伤害。
共鸣技能·阳焚身可在空中施放。

破秽
施放共鸣技能·阴蚀骨或共鸣技能·阳焚身时，获得破秽，持续4秒，满足下述条件之一时，破秽提前结束。
·切换至其他角色。
·切换至负阴状态或抱阳状态时。
·施放共鸣技能·黄泉渡或共鸣技能·往生送时。

共鸣技能·黄泉渡
若景燃处于负阴状态且持有破秽时，在空中按下普攻可施放共鸣技能·黄泉渡，攻击目标，造成热熔伤害，本次伤害为重击伤害。
施放共鸣技能·黄泉渡时可获得100点【炁】。
施放该技能后的一定时间内，按下普攻将会施放普攻·摄召第2段。

共鸣技能·往生送
若景燃处于抱阳状态且持有破秽时，在空中按下普攻可施放共鸣技能·往生送，攻击目标，造成热熔伤害，本次伤害为重击伤害。
施放共鸣技能·往生送时可获得100点【炁】。
施放该技能后的一定时间内，按下普攻将会施放普攻·灭煞第2段。
skills.descEn:
Resonance Skill - Encroaching Yin
While in the Yin Vessel state, Resonance Skill - Encroaching Yin is available, which deals Fusion DMG.
Resonance Skill - Encroaching Yin can be cast in mid-air.

Resonance Skill - Scorching Yang
While in the Yang Font state, Resonance Skill - Scorching Yang is available, which deals Fusion DMG.
Resonance Skill - Scorching Yang can be cast in mid-air.

Cleanse of Impurity
Casting Resonance Skill - Encroaching Yin or Resonance Skill - Scorching Yang grants Cleanse of Impurity for 4s or until one of the following conditions is met:
- Switching to another Resonator.
- Switching to the Yin Vessel or Yang Font state.
- Casting Resonance Skill - Netherworld Traverse or Resonance Skill - Afterlife's Guide.

Resonance Skill - Netherworld Traverse
While in the Yin Vessel state with Cleanse of Impurity, {Cus:Ipt,Touch=tap PC=press Gamepad=press} or hold Normal Attack in mid-air to cast Resonance Skill - Netherworld Traverse, dealing Fusion DMG, considered Heavy Attack DMG.
Casting Resonance Skill - Netherworld Traverse restores 100 {Cus:Sap,S=point P=points SapTag=1} of Qi.
{Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} or hold Normal Attack shortly after casting this skill to cast Basic Attack - Drink Soul Stage 2.

Resonance Skill - Afterlife's Guide
While in the Yang Font state with Cleanse of Impurity, {Cus:Ipt,Touch=tap PC=press Gamepad=press} or hold Normal Attack in mid-air to cast Resonance Skill - Afterlife's Guide, dealing Fusion DMG, considered Heavy Attack DMG.
Casting Resonance Skill - Afterlife's Guide restores 100 {Cus:Sap,S=point P=points SapTag=2} of Qi.
{Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} or hold Normal Attack shortly after casting this skill to cast Basic Attack - Devil's Bane Stage 2.

skills.name: 万鬼同葬
skills.desc:
共鸣解放·万鬼同葬可在低空施放。
攻击目标，造成热熔伤害，本次伤害为重击伤害，施放时获得100点【命火】。
施放后获得下述效果。
·若景燃的当前生命值大于生命上限的50%，将当前生命值降至生命上限的50%。
·获得200点【炁】。
·获得3层行途。
·进入荧惑状态，持续15秒。

行途
行途上限为3层，施放重击·劫魄或重击·踏罡时，获得200点【炁】，并减少1层行途，持续15秒。

荧惑
·重击·劫魄或重击·踏罡造成伤害时景燃召唤魑魅魍魉进行攻击，造成热熔伤害，本次伤害为重击伤害。每次重击·劫魄或重击·踏罡仅可触发一次。
·荧惑状态结束时清空【命火】。
skills.descEn:
Resonance Liberation - Burial of Thousand Souls can be cast in mid-air close to the ground.
Attack the target, dealing Fusion DMG, considered Heavy Attack DMG, and granting 100 {Cus:Sap,S=point P=points SapTag=0} of Fire of Life.
Gain the following effects after casting this skill:
- If Jingran's current HP is above 50% of the Max HP, reduce his current HP to 50% of the Max HP.
- Gain 200 {Cus:Sap,S=point P=points SapTag=3} of Qi.
- Gain 3 {Cus:Sap,S=stack P=stacks SapTag=4} of Wayfarer's Mark.
- Enter the Yinghuo state for 15s.

Wayfarer's Mark
Max 3 stacks.
Casting Heavy Attack - Soul Raid or Heavy Attack - Stardome Meander restores 200 {Cus:Sap,S=point P=points SapTag=7} of Qi and reduces 1 {Cus:Sap,S=stack P=stacks SapTag=8} of Wayfarer's Mark. This effect lasts for 15s.

Yinghuo
- Dealing damage with Heavy Attack - Soul Raid or Heavy Attack - Stardome Meander summons Chimei Wangliang to attack the targets, which deals Fusion DMG, considered Heavy Attack DMG. This effect can be triggered once per Heavy Attack - Soul Raid or Heavy Attack - Stardome Meander.
- All Fire of Life will be removed as Yinghuo ends.

skills.name: 贴壁听尘
skills.desc:
施放变奏技能·挑灯问冢，共鸣技能·阴蚀骨或共鸣技能·阳焚身时可获得画地。

画地
15秒内，若景燃为队伍中登场角色，造成伤害时获得生命上限1.6%+700的护盾，不可叠加，持续5秒，每0.5秒可生效一次。该护盾在切换至其他角色时不会继承。
处于荧惑状态时，若景燃为队伍中登场角色，造成伤害时额外获得生命上限0.8%+350的护盾，不可叠加，持续5秒，每0.5秒可生效一次。该护盾在切换至其他角色时不会继承。
skills.descEn:
Casting Intro Skill - Question the Tombs, Resonance Skill - Encroaching Yin, or Resonance Skill - Scorching Yang grants Earth Charm.

Earth Charm
For 15s, if Jingran is the active Resonator in the team, gain an unstackable Shield equal to 1.6% of Max HP + 700 that lasts for 5s when dealing damage. This effect can be triggered once every 0.5s. This Shield will not be passed on to the incoming Resonator.
While Jingran is in the Yinghuo state, if he is the active Resonator in the team, he gains an unstackable Shield equal to 0.8% of Max HP + 350 that lasts for 5s when dealing damage. This effect can be triggered once every 0.5s. This Shield will not be passed on to the incoming Resonator.

skills.name: 扫痕观迹
skills.desc:
每次进入战斗时，若景燃持有的【鬼护】不足25点，补充至25点，每4秒可触发1次。

附近队伍中除景燃以外的角色获得护盾时，景燃获得2点【鬼护】，每0.5秒可触发一次。

敛神
·每次进入战斗时，景燃获得敛神，每4秒可触发1次。
·施放延奏技能·收山出煞时，景燃获得敛神。
·附近队伍中除景燃以外的角色获得护盾时，景燃获得15点【鬼护】，并移除敛神。
skills.descEn:
Upon entering combat, if Jingran's Ghost Shroud is below 25 points, restore it to 25 points. This effect can be triggered once every 4s.

When nearby Resonators in the team other than Jingran gain a Shield, Jingran gains 2 {Cus:Sap,S=point P=points SapTag=3} of Ghost Shroud. This effect can be triggered once every 0.5s.

Fixation
- Upon entering combat, Jingran gains Fixation. This effect can be triggered once every 4s.
- Casting Outro Skill - Rising Fortune and Ebbing Evil grants Fixation.
- When nearby Resonators in the team other than Jingran gain a Shield, Jingran gains 15 {Cus:Sap,S=point P=points SapTag=6} of Ghost Shroud and removes Fixation.

skills.name: 挑灯问冢
skills.desc:
攻击目标，造成热熔伤害。消耗全部【鬼护】，并转化为相同层数的祸兮福兮。
施放变奏技能·挑灯问冢时可获得100点【炁】。
若景燃处于负阴状态，施放该技能后的一定时间内，按下普攻将会施放普攻·摄召第2段。
若景燃处于抱阳状态，施放该技能后的一定时间内，按下普攻将会施放普攻·灭煞第2段。

祸兮福兮
祸兮福兮上限为50层，每层祸兮福兮使得景燃基于生命上限获得额外热熔伤害加成提升：景燃每1000生命上限获得0.05%热熔伤害加成提升，每层最多以此方式使得景燃获得2.5%热熔伤害加成提升，持续15秒。
若切换至其他角色则该效果提前结束。

【鬼护】获取规则
·【鬼护】上限为50点。
·景燃获得护盾时，可获得1点【鬼护】，每0.5秒可生效一次。
skills.descEn:
Attack the target, dealing Fusion DMG. Consume and convert all Ghost Shroud to equal stacks of Fortune in Disguise.
Casting Question the Tombs restores 100 {Cus:Sap,S=point P=points SapTag=0} of Qi.
While in the Yin Vessel state, {Cus:Ipt,Touch=tap PC=press Gamepad=press} or hold Normal Attack shortly after casting this skill to cast Basic Attack - Drink Soul Stage 2.
While in the Yang Font state, {Cus:Ipt,Touch=tap PC=press Gamepad=press} or hold Normal Attack shortly after casting this skill to cast Basic Attack - Devil's Bane Stage 2.

Fortune in Disguise
Max 50 stacks. Each stack of Fortune in Disguise grants additional Fusion DMG Bonus based on Jingran's Max HP: For every 1000 points of Max HP, Jingran gains 0.05% additional Fusion DMG Bonus for 15s, up to 2.5% for each stack of Fortune in Disguise.
Switching to another Resonator ends the effect.

Ghost Shroud
- Max 50 points.
- When Jingran gains a Shield, he gains 1 {Cus:Sap,S=point P=points SapTag=7} of Ghost Shroud. This effect can be triggered once every 0.5s.

skills.name: 逆渡三途
skills.desc:
炁机斡旋
景燃施放重击·劫魄或重击·踏罡可以在负阴状态和抱阳状态之间切换，景燃初始处于抱阳状态。

重击·劫魄
若景燃拥有300点【炁】，且处于负阴状态，长按普攻消耗300点【炁】可施放重击·劫魄，造成热熔伤害。
施放重击·劫魄后切换至抱阳状态。
施放该技能后的一定时间内，按下普攻将会施放普攻·灭煞第2段。

重击·踏罡
若景燃拥有300点【炁】，且处于抱阳状态，长按普攻消耗300点【炁】可施放重击·踏罡，造成热熔伤害。
施放重击·踏罡后切换至负阴状态。
施放该技能后的一定时间内，按下普攻将会施放普攻·摄召第2段。
重击·踏罡可在空中施放。

【炁】获取规则
【炁】上限300点。
·施放普攻·摄召第3段、普攻·摄召第4段、普攻·灭煞第3段或普攻·灭煞第4段时，获得50点【炁】。
·施放闪避反击·探幽、闪避反击·守明、共鸣技能·黄泉渡、共鸣技能·往生送或变奏技能·挑灯问冢时，获得100点【炁】。
·施放共鸣解放·万鬼同葬或持有行途时施放重击·劫魄或重击·踏罡，获得200点【炁】。

【命火】获取规则
【命火】上限100点。
·施放共鸣解放·万鬼同葬时获得100点【命火】。
·荧惑状态结束时清空【命火】。
若景燃处于荧惑状态且景燃持有的【命火】不为0时，施放重击·劫魄或重击·踏罡时消耗25点【命火】，并使本次重击·劫魄或重击·踏罡的伤害倍率基于景燃生命上限增加：景燃自身生命上限大于25000点时，每超过1000点生命上限增加重击·劫魄或重击·踏罡伤害倍率，最多计入25000点生命上限。

幽而复明
·景燃的防御始终为0。
·景燃基于生命上限提升受到的治疗效果：景燃每1000点生命上限提升6.2%受到的治疗效果，上限310%。
·景燃基于生命上限获得热熔伤害加成提升：景燃每1000点生命上限获得1.5%热熔伤害加成提升，上限75%。

阳变阴合
景燃基于生命上限获得额外攻击：景燃每1000点生命上限获得36点攻击，上限1800。
skills.descEn:
Qi Modulation
Jingran switches between the Yin Vessel and Yang Font states by casting Heavy Attack - Soul Raid or Heavy Attack - Stardome Meander. Jingran is in the Yang Font state by default.

Heavy Attack - Soul Raid
When Jingran holds 300 points of Qi while in the Yin Vessel state, hold Normal Attack to consume 300 {Cus:Sap,S=point P=points SapTag=1} of Qi to cast Heavy Attack - Soul Raid, dealing Fusion DMG.
After casting Heavy Attack - Soul Raid, Jingran switches to the Yang Font state.
{Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} or hold Normal Attack shortly after casting this skill to cast Basic Attack - Devil's Bane Stage 2.

Heavy Attack - Stardome Meander
When Jingran holds 300 points of Qi while in the Yang Font state, hold Normal Attack to consume 300 {Cus:Sap,S=point P=points SapTag=3} of Qi to cast Heavy Attack - Stardome Meander, dealing Fusion DMG.
After casting Heavy Attack - Stardome Meander, Jingran switches to the Yin Vessel state.
{Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} or hold Normal Attack shortly after casting this skill to cast Basic Attack - Drink Soul Stage 2.
Heavy Attack - Stardome Meander can be cast in mid-air.

Qi
Max 300 points.
- Casting Basic Attack - Drink Soul Stage 3, Basic Attack - Drink Soul Stage 4, Basic Attack - Devil's Bane Stage 3, or Basic Attack - Devil's Bane Stage 4 restores 50 {Cus:Sap,S=point P=points SapTag=5} of Qi.
- Casting Dodge Counter - Nether Dive, Dodge Counter - Light Watch, Resonance Skill - Netherworld Traverse, Resonance Skill - Afterlife's Guide, or Intro Skill - Question the Tombs restores 100 {Cus:Sap,S=point P=points SapTag=6} of Qi.
- Casting Resonance Liberation - Burial of Thousand Souls or casting Heavy Attack - Soul Raid or Heavy Attack - Stardome Meander with Wayfarer's Mark restores 200 {Cus:Sap,S=point P=points SapTag=7} of Qi.

Fire of Life
Max 100 points.
- Casting Resonance Liberation - Burial of Thousand Souls grants 100 {Cus:Sap,S=point P=points SapTag=9} of Fire of Life.
- All Fire of Life is cleared when Yinghuo ends.
While in Yinghuo, if Fire of Life is not at 0 {Cus:Sap,S=point P=points SapTag=A}, casting Heavy Attack - Soul Raid or Heavy Attack - Stardome Meander consumes 25 {Cus:Sap,S=point P=points SapTag=B} of Fire of Life, and the DMG Multiplier of this Heavy Attack - Soul Raid or Heavy Attack - Stardome Meander is increased based on Jingran's Max HP: The DMG Multiplier of this Heavy Attack - Soul Raid or Heavy Attack - Stardome Meander is increased for every 1000 {Cus:Sap,S=point P=points SapTag=C} of Jingran's Max HP over 25000. Up to 25000 points of Jingran's Max HP count towards this effect.

Nether to Light
- Jingran's DEF is fixed at 0.
- Jingran gains Incoming Healing Bonus based on Max HP: For every 1000 {Cus:Sap,S=point P=points SapTag=D} of Max HP, Jingran receives 6.2% Incoming Healing Bonus, up to 310%.
- Jingran gains Fusion DMG Bonus based on Max HP: For every 1000 {Cus:Sap,S=point P=points SapTag=E} of Max HP, Jingran receives 1.5% Fusion DMG Bonus, up to 75%.

Yang Changes, Yin Unites
Jingran gains additional ATK based on Max HP: For every 1000 {Cus:Sap,S=point P=points SapTag=F} of Max HP, Jingran gains 36 additional ATK, up to 1800.

skills.name: 巧手烹调
skills.desc: 当前角色烹饪时有概率产出特色料理
skills.descEn: Has a chance to produce special dishes when cooking.

skills.name: 收山出煞
skills.desc: 造成景燃795%攻击的热熔伤害。
skills.descEn: Deal Fusion DMG equal to 795% of Jingran's ATK.

skills.name: 谐度破坏·长刃
skills.desc:
目标【偏谐值】满时，可对其施放【谐度破坏】。
若景燃处于负阴状态，施放该技能后的一定时间内，按下普攻将会施放普攻·摄召第2段。
若景燃处于抱阳状态，施放该技能后的一定时间内，按下普攻将会施放普攻·灭煞第2段。
skills.descEn:
When the target's Off-Tune Level is full, the Resonator may cast Tune Break on the target.
While in Yin Vessel, {Cus:Ipt,Touch=tap PC=press Gamepad=press} or hold Normal Attack shortly after casting this skill to Basic Attack - Drink Soul Stage 2.
While in Yang Font, {Cus:Ipt,Touch=tap PC=press Gamepad=press} or hold Normal Attack shortly after casting this skill to Basic Attack - Devil's Bane Stage 2.

inherents.name: 贴壁听尘
inherents.desc:
施放变奏技能·挑灯问冢，共鸣技能·阴蚀骨或共鸣技能·阳焚身时可获得画地。

画地
15秒内，若景燃为队伍中登场角色，造成伤害时获得生命上限1.6%+700的护盾，不可叠加，持续5秒，每0.5秒可生效一次。该护盾在切换至其他角色时不会继承。
处于荧惑状态时，若景燃为队伍中登场角色，造成伤害时额外获得生命上限0.8%+350的护盾，不可叠加，持续5秒，每0.5秒可生效一次。该护盾在切换至其他角色时不会继承。

inherents.name: 扫痕观迹
inherents.desc:
每次进入战斗时，若景燃持有的【鬼护】不足25点，补充至25点，每4秒可触发1次。

附近队伍中除景燃以外的角色获得护盾时，景燃获得2点【鬼护】，每0.5秒可触发一次。

敛神
·每次进入战斗时，景燃获得敛神，每4秒可触发1次。
·施放延奏技能·收山出煞时，景燃获得敛神。
·附近队伍中除景燃以外的角色获得护盾时，景燃获得15点【鬼护】，并移除敛神。

chains.name: 阴阳其和，终始其义
chains.nameEn: Yin and Yang in Harmony, the Ultimate Law of Being
chains.desc:
共鸣技能·阴蚀骨，共鸣技能·黄泉渡，共鸣技能·阳焚身，共鸣技能·往生送伤害倍率提升80%。
共鸣技能·阴蚀骨，共鸣技能·黄泉渡，共鸣技能·阳焚身，共鸣技能·往生送免疫打断。
chains.descEn:
The DMG Multipliers of Resonance Skill - Encroaching Yin, Resonance Skill - Netherworld Traverse, Resonance Skill - Scorching Yang, and Resonance Skill - Afterlife's Guide are increased by 80%.
Resonance Skill - Encroaching Yin, Resonance Skill - Netherworld Traverse, Resonance Skill - Scorching Yang, and Resonance Skill - Afterlife's Guide are now immune to interruption.

chains.name: 孤灯踩影，有迹山河
chains.nameEn: A Solitary Lantern, Across Lands Shade-Trodden
chains.desc:
重击·劫魄和重击·踏罡伤害倍率提升46%。荧惑状态下【命火】对重击·劫魄或重击·踏罡的倍率增加效果提升46%。

每次进入战斗时，景燃获得下述效果，每4秒可触发1次。
·获得300点【炁】。
·景燃获得通幽。

通幽
施放重击·劫魄或重击·踏罡时，回复共鸣能量上限25%的共鸣能量且重击·劫魄和重击·踏罡造成的伤害加深180%，持续4秒。
chains.descEn:
The DMG Multipliers of Heavy Attack - Soul Raid and Heavy Attack - Stardome Meander are increased by 46%. While in the Yinghuo state, the DMG Multiplier increase effect via Fire of Life on Heavy Attack - Soul Raid and Heavy Attack - Stardome Meander is increased by 46%.

Upon entering combat, Jingran gains the following effects, triggered once every 4s:
- Gains 300 {Cus:Sap,S=point P=points SapTag=3} of Qi.
- Gains Netherworld's Boon.

Netherworld's Boon
Casting Heavy Attack - Soul Raid or Heavy Attack - Stardome Meander restores 25% of Max Resonance Energy and grants Heavy Attack - Soul Raid and Heavy Attack - Stardome Meander 180% DMG Amplification for 4s.

chains.name: 乾道变化，各正性命
chains.nameEn: World's Course Shifts, Each to Their Rightful Paths
chains.desc:
景燃施放重击·劫魄或重击·踏罡时，获得5点【鬼护】。

景燃施放共鸣解放·万鬼同葬后，阳变阴合替换为阴阳交错，持续15秒。

阴阳交错
景燃基于生命上限获得额外攻击：景燃每1000点生命上限获得50点攻击，上限2500。
chains.descEn:
When Jingran casts Heavy Attack - Soul Raid or Heavy Attack - Stardome Meander, gain 5 {Cus:Sap,S=point P=points SapTag=0} of Ghost Shroud.

When Jingran casts Resonance Liberation - Burial of Thousand Souls, Yang Changes, Yin Unites is replaced by Yin-Yang Everflow for 15s.

Yin-Yang Everflow
Jingran gains additional ATK based on Max HP: For every 1000 {Cus:Sap,S=point P=points SapTag=2} of Jingran's Max HP, gain 50 additional ATK, up to 2500.

chains.name: 虚实莫辨，人鬼无间
chains.nameEn: Where Reality Meets Illusion, Where Living Meet Dead
chains.desc: 队伍中的角色获得护盾时，使队伍中的角色全属性伤害加成提升20%，持续30秒。
chains.descEn: When a Resonator in the team gains a Shield, all Resonators in the team gain 20% All-Attribute DMG Bonus for 30s.

chains.name: 原始反终，故知死生
chains.nameEn: Ends Return to Beginnings, Truth of Life Laid Bare
chains.desc: 景燃受到致死伤害时，此次伤害不会使景燃倒下，并获得基于景燃生命上限50%的护盾，护盾持续15秒，该效果每10分钟可触发一次，该护盾在切换至其他角色时不会继承。
chains.descEn: When Jingran takes a fatal blow, he will not fall and will instead gain a Shield equal to 50% of Max HP for 15s. This effect can be triggered once every 10 min. This Shield will not be passed on to the incoming Resonator.

chains.name: 恩仇了了，后文有期
chains.nameEn: As Favors and Feuds Fade, New Stories Await
chains.desc:
目标受到景燃的重击伤害提升40%。

魑魅魍魉伤害倍率提升80%。

进入荧惑状态后，景燃获得万鬼同行，持续15秒。万鬼同行持续期间，若景燃为队伍中登场角色，景燃造成伤害时，召唤魑魅魍魉攻击目标，对目标造成热熔伤害，本次伤害为重击伤害。

此方式召唤魑魅魍魉间隔为1秒，最多以此方式召唤8次，满足任一下述条件时，移除万鬼同行并重置魑魅魍魉的召唤次数。
·施放共鸣解放·万鬼同葬时。
·荧惑持续时间结束或被移除时。
chains.descEn:
Targets take 40% more Heavy Attack DMG from Jingran.

The DMG Multiplier of Chimei Wangliang is increased by 80%.

Upon entering the Yinghuo state, Jingran gains the Parade of Thousand Souls effect for 15s. During this effect, if Jingran is the active Resonator in the team, upon dealing damage, Jingran summons Chimei Wangliang to attack the targets, dealing Fusion DMG, considered Heavy Attack DMG.

Chimei Wangliang can be summoned this way at an interval of 1s for up to 8 times. Parade of Thousand Souls ends and the available summon charges of Chimei Wangliang reset when either of the following conditions is met:
- Cast Resonance Liberation - Burial of Thousand Souls.
- Yinghuo ends or is removed.
